final_rationale: The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response mainly narrows the claim and reframes the same record. That clarification is useful but does not satisfy the unresolved compliance predicate. On the available evidence, general readiness supports operational launch readiness, but model-card certification for a named deployment context with missing evaluation coverage remains unsupported unless the gap was actually disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance. Because this role has no admissible evidence that any of those conditions was met, the concern from the initial audit remains unresolved. The narrowed position could support compliant_with_caveats only if there were evidence that the caveat was actually implemented in the certification record or model-card language. Here, that implementation is asserted as the right remedy, not evidenced as completed.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the model card was actually corrected to disclose the refund-policy summarization evaluation gap.
No admissible evidence shows the missing refund-policy summarization evaluations were completed.
No admissible evidence shows an approved risk acceptance authorizing certification despite the unresolved named-context gap.
The policy text makes disclosure or resolution a condition for clean certification on named deployment contexts, and that condition is still unproven on this record.
